control_definitions.conformers: At least two independently initialized donor torsion patterns per molecule; document retention or convergence to the same minimum.
control_definitions.fixed_torsion: For all three molecules freeze the three core–linker torsions at 45 degrees and relax other S0 coordinates. Define each four-atom torsion using the common core numbering and mapped linker ortho carbon; carry a signed orientation convention. This is a benchmark intervention, not a claimed minimum. The supplied mapping resolves each core/linker bond without requiring source coordinate numbering.
control_definitions.state_tracking: Compute at least S1,S2,T1,T2 and enlarge the root window to demonstrate state matching. Compare NTO/density overlap and identical core/three-donor partitions.
control_definitions.relaxation: Obtain state-followed S1 and T1 relaxed energies for each molecule; avoid root-switching into another excited state.

observable_definition: Vertical gap=E(S1;R_S0)-E(T1;R_S0); adiabatic gap=E(S1;R_S1)-E(T1;R_T1). Do not mix these or use Kohn–Sham gaps as excitation gaps. SOC is the norm of three spin components in cm^-1 with operator and state basis stated.

required_comparisons.description: Six matched vertical-state and SOC panels
Position versus geometry and method robustness

optional_not_scored: OLED host/device modeling, absolute RISC rates and additional donor series are optional.
source_note: Molecular identities, benchmark-defined starts and explicitly labelled measured observations are authorized inputs. Graph provenance identifies chemical identity only; state labels, optimized added geometries and predicted outputs are withheld. See task.md for the common scientific scope.
public_private_boundary: Identity/connectivity and declared measured observations are public. Author optimized new candidate geometries, computed rankings, reference outputs and legacy PASS archives are private.
